_about: Ad hooks for message match: /breathe?h=<id> shows the ad's own first line above the page's one-line description and goes straight to that session (the picker becomes a small link). Draft lines: each must match a live ad word for word, and carries no effect claim (the lead and Isak sign off). Unknown ids are ignored.
